title: Grateful Dead Live at Greensboro Coliseum on 1989-03-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > dBpoweramp > Adobe Audition CC2015 > Samplitude Pro X4 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Warm matrix recording captures an intimate hallway vibe with a standout Dark Star at a historic venue
ai_review.review: The ultramatrix source delivers a surprisingly clear and well‑balanced sound that feels like a living‑room jam, with speakers described as "just right" and the space fostering dancing. Reviewers highlight the Dark Star as a high point, noting its energy despite the venue’s unconventional hallway setting.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one enthusiastic review is available; it praises both the performance (especially Dark Star) and the overall sound, but limited data prevents a higher confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review mentions speakers were "just right" and the ambience felt intimate; no complaints about muddiness or drop‑outs, suggesting a clean matrix capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The hall’s hallway atmosphere created a relaxed, dance‑friendly flow that felt like a living‑room gathering, enhancing the overall vibe of the show.
